comparisons.peer_topic: Municipal Bond Trusts Operations and Risk Profile

At December 31, 2024, liquidity commitments to these unconsolidated trusts totaled $1.8 billion (compared to $1.7 billion in 2023), with bonds having a weighted-average remaining life of 11.1 years; no significant write-downs or downgrades occurred in 2024, 2023, or 2022.

C states it had no liquidity or reimbursement agreements at Dec 31, 2024, whereas BAC reported liquidity commitments totaling $1.8 billion at the same date. This reflects a significant divergence in exposure and support for these specific trusts between the two firms.
